title: Vertical rod
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch. On the first face, draw a circle with its center at coordinates [0.0082, 0.0082] and a radius of 0.0082. Move to the second face and draw another circle with the same radius but centered at [0.0082, 0.1007]. After completing the circles, apply a scaling factor of 0.1089 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it using Euler angles of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it with a vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. To transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units without extruding in the opposite direction. This extrusion will create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the vertical rod with a cylindrical base and rectangular top will be 0.016438356164383564 units in length, 0.10890410958904112 units in width, and 0.7500000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the cylindrical base
cylinder = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0082, 0.0082)  # Move to the center of the base
    .circle(0.0082)  # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical base
)

# Create the rectangular top
rectangle = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0082, 0.1007)  # Move to the center of the top
    .circle(0.0082)  # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the rectangular top
)

# Combine the parts
r = cylinder.union(rectangle)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the first circle
circle_1 = workplane.center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(0.0082)

# Create the second circle
circle_2 = workplane.center(0.0082, 0.1007).circle(0.0082)

# Combine the circles into a single sketch
sketch = circle_1.add(circle_2)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Final model
r = extrusion

import cadquery as cq

# Two parallel cylindrical rods, each 0.0164 in diameter and 0.75 long,
# spaced apart along Y so the combined Y extent is 0.1089
d = 0.0164
rod1 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(d / 2).extrude(0.75)
rod2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.1089 - 0.0082).circle(d / 2).extrude(0.75)

r = rod1.union(rod2)
